properties.name: ANSWERS: a design record can name the Question it answered — the edge the schema described for months without it existing
properties.rationale:
THE CONSTRAINT THAT SHAPED IT CAME FROM AGENTS.md, NOT FROM ME: "an additive schema change leaves mixed-vintage nodes rather than backfilling — ask what happens to a graph written by the previous version."

MEASURED HERE, 2026-09-02: THIS DESIGN HOLDS 52 ANSWERED QUESTIONS AND NOT ONE OF THEM CAN HONESTLY BE LINKED. Their gaps are closed and nothing records which node was the answer; assigning one now would be guessing, and the brainstorm skill's rule — never invent a relation, a false neighbour is worse than a missing one — applies exactly. So the feature ships having drawn zero edges on its own design, and that is the correct outcome rather than an embarrassment.

IT IS ALSO THE PROOF OF THE RULE. If a missing ANSWERS edge counted as debt, this design would have invented 52 items of it on the day the edge shipped, and every consumer graph proportionally. So the edge is POSITIVE EVIDENCE ONLY: `loop_status` reports how many answers name their record and says in words that an unnamed one is not evidence the answer went unwritten. That is the same principle as the fix shipped hours earlier in #415 — do not assert what the computation cannot reach — arrived at from the opposite direction, which is some evidence it is the right principle rather than a local patch.

WHAT IS NOT CLOSED, named so this is not read as finishing the job: the third leg. reflow2's own doctrine says vocabulary reaches a design only with a typed tool, an instruction, AND a detector that notices absence. The first two are here. The third is deliberately NOT a gap or a defect — nothing will ever nag anyone into drawing this edge, because on a mixed-vintage graph that nag would be false. Whether absence should start counting once a design has demonstrably begun using the edge is a real question nobody has been asked.
properties.subject: system
properties.summary:
New edge type `ANSWERS`, `from: "*"` → `to: Question`, with a typed `answers` tool, a core `answers()` helper, the instruction in the detect-and-ask skill, and `loop_status.answered_naming_their_record` reading it.

THE SCHEMA HAD ALREADY DESCRIBED THIS EDGE. `Question.answer` reads "What the user said, in their own words. The design nodes it produced are linked separately" — and nothing linked them, separately or otherwise. Measured 2026-09-02: `describe_schema{Decision, Question}` returned ZERO exact and ZERO half-exact matches. So this is not new vocabulary invented; it is vocabulary the schema promised and never delivered.

THREE INDEPENDENT REPORTS WANTED THIS ONE EDGE: proj:chama reading loop debt on a correctly-deferred answer (2026-09-02); api-boss finding a Question created outside gap_to_prompt permanently unanswerable and proposing exactly this as fix (3) (2026-08-15); and the open question of whether a Question's recorded wording can be amended, which needs somewhere to hang the amendment.

SHAPE, and both halves are deliberate. `to` is ENUMERATED so `describe_schema` ranks it `half_exact` instead of burying it in the both-sides-wildcard pile — applying `fact:governed-by-is-the-governance-edge-and-describe-schema-can-never-rank-it` rather than repeating it. `from` STAYS OPEN because an answer is not always a Decision: it can land as a Requirement, a Capability or a status move, and narrowing a wildcard later is a consumer-facing break.

DELIBERATELY ABSENT FROM THE IMPACT TABLE, and the code comment records that the question was ASKED rather than missed — nodes.rs warns in its own words that "twice now a new edge type has reached a Release without anyone asking whether the impact table should know about it". A Question is a record of HAVING ASKED, not a link in the golden thread; ASKS_ABOUT is outside for the same reason and AUTHORED_BY says outright it "never enlarges a blast radius". Adding ANSWERS would drag every Question into design_network() and make each one a fresh island for unthreaded_cluster.

FIVE TESTS, WRITTEN FIRST. The initial run failed on exactly one thing — `edge::ANSWERS` absent. They pin: a record naming its question and the question naming its answerer; the open source side; that an ANSWERS edge to a non-Question is REFUSED (the half that must hold, since a wildcard target would validate and mean nothing); that the loop counts linked answers; and that a design written before the edge existed is not thereby in debt.

Stamp moves 64 → 65 edge types, so an upgrade doc is owed at cut time per flow:release-cut.
